results.title: tenant routing table - stale row and the eject path
results.detail: isolation: tenant-a 400 while tenant-b 502 on the poisoned row; eject = a 11701ms redeploy (tenant-b -> 404)
results.evidence:
poisoned table: tenant-a 400 (origin=tenant-a), tenant-b 502 (origin=tenant-b->dead)
after eject: tenant-a 400 (unaffected), tenant-b 404 (ejected)

results.title: storage dual-write viability (parallel write, partial failure, sync-after)
results.detail: dual-write 200/200 (skew 107ms, bytes equal); partial failure 200/400 is not atomic; sync-after 97ms closes the gap
results.evidence:
dual-write shared.bin: primary 200 in 432ms, standby 200 in 325ms
read-back: primary 200, standby 200, bytes equal: yes
partial failure shape: primary 200, standby 400 ({"statusCode":"404","error":"Bucket not found","message":"Bucket not found","code":"NoSuchBucket"}) - dual-write is not atomic; the object exists on one side only
sync-after partial.bin -> standby: HTTP 200 in 97ms
